overview: AI receptionist that answers calls around the clock, books dental appointments and runs a three-stage reminder sequence.

blocks.p: Front-desk staff were stretched by booking calls at peak times, and missed appointments were a recurring problem.

A Vapi voice agent answers calls at any hour and books appointments, with records handed to GoHighLevel. n8n then runs an escalating three-stage reminder sequence before each visit, designed to cut down on no-shows.
